_comment: Design functions: the left-hand descent of the V model. Each entry decomposes one or more capability requirements into a unit of design that can be verified by a unit test. IDs are FN-<AREA>-NNN and are stable once published. 'satisfies' must reference requirement IDs that exist in specs/capabilities/. Unit tests are NOT listed here - they are discovered from test code by the FN id in the test name, so this file cannot go stale.

FN-CC-001.name: Parse an ePI document Bundle anchored by a Composition

FN-CC-002.name: Assign a canonical identifier to a document

FN-CC-003.name: Create an immutable version snapshot and record its lineage

FN-CC-004.name: Persist canonical content through the FHIR REST API

FN-CC-005.name: Retrieve a document by canonical identifier and version

FN-CC-006.name: Serialise and deserialise a Bundle without content loss

FN-CC-007.name: Reject any mutation of an existing version

FN-VAL-001.name: Check structural well-formedness against the pinned profile

FN-VAL-002.name: Check reference integrity, rejecting dangling references

FN-VAL-003.name: Produce structured issues carrying severity and element location

FN-VAL-004.name: Validate correctly when several writes arrive at once

FN-IAM-001.name: Validate an OIDC access token and extract subject claims

FN-IAM-002.name: Build an authorisation query from subject, action, and resource

FN-IAM-003.name: Evaluate the policy decision and enforce allow or deny

FN-IAM-004.name: Apply affiliate and market scope filtering at data access

FN-IAM-005.name: Resolve the scopes a caller may search within, from the policy that decides a read

FN-AUD-001.name: Compose an audit record with actor, action, target, before and after values

FN-AUD-002.name: Append an audit record to the append-only store

FN-AUD-003.name: Reject update or delete of an existing audit record

FN-AUD-004.name: Record every access-control decision to the audit sink

FN-CFG-001.name: Load market definitions from configuration data

FN-CFG-002.name: Resolve the active profile version for a market

FN-CFG-003.name: Reject a market definition that fails schema validation

FN-CFG-004.name: Apply the governance schema as ordered, recorded migrations

FN-CFG-005.name: Resolve every configuration path at start-up and refuse to run without one

FN-MDM-001.name: Resolve a product reference through a replaceable master-data directory

FN-TRM-001.name: Record the terminology versions a version was approved against

FN-TRM-002.name: Report the terminology bindings a deployment answers from

FN-AUT-001.name: Bound the narrative an author can produce to what validates

FN-AUT-002.name: Hold a working copy of a version until the author saves

FN-AUT-003.name: Present a label's sections without exposing FHIR

FN-EVT-001.name: Build a content event from a persisted document

FN-EVT-002.name: Publish a content event to the event backbone

FN-CC-008.name: Assign a stable identifier to every section at creation

FN-LCM-001.name: Load the lifecycle state model from configuration

FN-LCM-002.name: Reject a transition the state model does not permit

FN-LCM-003.name: Record a transition with actor, timestamp and reason

FN-LCM-004.name: Hold per-market approval state separately from internal state

FN-LCM-005.name: Pin the content snapshot and its validating context at approval

FN-LCM-006.name: Reconstruct a version's state at any past moment from its transitions

FN-WFL-001.name: Route a version for review and approval

FN-WFL-002.name: Refuse an approval by the author of the version, by any route

FN-LCM-007.name: Require a signature to submit to a regulator, and none to record its decision

FN-LCM-008.name: Report registrations with no content behind them

FN-WFL-003.name: Require a valid, unused signature at a gate the model says must be signed

FN-WFL-004.name: Select a routing model by label type and market

FN-AUD-005.name: Capture an electronic signature over the hash of the pinned version

FN-SCH-001.name: Search labels by market, status and identifier, scoped to the caller

FN-SCH-002.name: Retrieve the current-approved version for a market

FN-TPL-001.name: Instantiate a conformant draft from an approved template

FN-TPL-002.name: Record the template version a label was instantiated from
